name: Rayden
body:
She’s a very beautiful and lithe elven woman. Her tongue is sharper than her dagger, but she doesn’t show any fear following her master into battle.

Rayden
CR 3

XP 800
Female elf expert 5
CN Medium humanoid (elf)
Init +3; Senses Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 10 (+3 Dex)
hp 21 (5d8-5)
Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +4

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee unarmed strike +2 (1d3-1 nonlethal) or dagger +2 (1d4-1)
Ranged dagger +6 (1d4-1)

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 16, Con 8, Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 18
Base Atk +3; CMB +2; CMD 4
Feats Alertness, Great Fortitude, Skill Focus (Bluff, Profession)
Skills Acrobatics +11, Bluff +15, Disguise +12, Intimidate +12, Knowledge (local) +7, Linguistics +4, Perception +10, Perform (sing or dance) +12, Profession (companion) +13, Ride +7, Sense Motive +10
Languages Common, Dwarf, Elven, Gnome, Sylvan

Gear

Concealed +1 dagger (in the bedpost or other piece of furniture) 10gp
Hat of disguise worth 1,800gp
Decoration and jewelry worth 500gp
Costumes and outfits worth 1000gp
